parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key and doc_id, then join docs on doc_id to get pubmed_id and doi. Join compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target name Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
